assets.full_prompt:
Use case: stylized-concept
Asset type: canonical career-world wide geography concept sheet for world/career-world@v1
Input images: none by default. If the same canonical tracer PNG is attached, use it only as a style and identity reference; never as an edit target, geometry source, coordinate truth, or permission to change topology.
Primary request: A wide isometric career-world geography reference: one coherent coastal land system with five clearly separated buildable employer districts centered at NinjaOne (340,370), Tanium (800,350), Independent (1240,380), ACE Hardware (380,700), and Column Technologies (1200,700), plus navigable negative-space water and terrain corridors and no authored city geometry.
Scene/backdrop: one isolated world land-and-water identity on a near-black navy technical drafting field with a faint true-isometric grid; no surrounding scene.
Style/medium: restrained technical-cartography line art, matte low-value terrain faces, thin parallel strokes, minimal bloom, traceable hard edges, no perspective convergence.
Composition/framing: wide landscape canonical geography sheet in the locked 1600 x 900 authored frame. Show four separated, unobscured panels: LOD-0 landmass envelope; LOD-1 terrain divisions and five empty buildable districts; LOD-2 secondary terrain/coast detail; and one solid silhouette inset of the landmass. This world sheet alone may show the five districts.
Projection: orthographic true-isometric; camera azimuth 225 degrees from north, look direction 45 degrees, elevation 35.264 degrees, roll 0; +Y projects upper-left; no authored rotation.
Lighting/mood: fixed graphic face values, quiet and legible, no cinematic lighting and no cast shadow.
Color palette: global near-black navy field #080B10, surface #0D1219, ink #F0EEE7, focus #8CE8F8; use only restrained, mechanically separable hints from the five employer palette families at the five district anchors. Emissive detail may cover at most 3 percent of visible terrain-face area.
Materials/textures: matte technical-cartography terrain faces only; top, lit side, and shadow side use deterministic palette values.
Text (verbatim): none.
Constraints: This is the sole multi-district geography exception. Keep the authored frame, coastline envelope, landmass centroid, terrain orientation, district footprints, and exact anchor relationships unchanged across LODs. Center the five empty buildable districts at NinjaOne (340,370), Tanium (800,350), Independent (1240,380), ACE Hardware (380,700), and Column Technologies (1200,700); use these as composition guides but render no coordinate marks or numbers. Roads, routes, contours, water fills, labels, and all city/project/skill buildings remain code-native. LOD adds only secondary terrain and coastline detail. Geometry must be reconstructable as deterministic SVG without guessing hidden edges.
Avoid: generated text, labels, initials, numbers, coordinate marks, pseudo-text, logos, wordmarks, mascots, or watermarks; perspective convergence, camera rotation, cast shadows, PBR, photorealism, glass, chrome, cyberpunk neon, or fantasy styling; graph or dashboard layouts, logo plinths, unsupported factual architecture, private details, metrics, or real-campus implication; melted terrain joins, inconsistent axes, hidden geometry, coastline or anchor drift between LODs; moving or inventing employer anchors; rendering project or skill buildings; turning the map into a dashboard.
Easter egg rule: No easter egg in the canonical sheet. Any later approved decoration must be a single optional LOD-2 attachment that does not alter footprint, silhouette, evidence, or interaction.
findings: Four separated landmass/terrain/silhouette panels; five empty district pads; no text, coordinate marks, logos, or authored buildings. Raster is 1672x941, scale-equivalent 16:9 rather than literal 1600x900.
defects: raster_dimension_scaling: Generated raster is 1672x941, scale-equivalent 16:9 rather than literal 1600x900.
